_meta.description: Hover-keyword glossary: mechanical term definitions plus skill and minion name references.
notes: keyword_lookup maps every keyword variant (Stun/Stuns/Stunned/...) straight to its definition text for direct hover lookup.
skill_references cover every skill in the database (name -> card); the in-game glossary registers hero base + minion skills, but all skill names are exported so any name in hover text resolves.
minion_references come from the glossary's authoritative minion_info table (canonical display name + base HP). hp_dynamic=true means HP is set at runtime (shown as 'X' in source).

skill_references.name: Stored Charge
skill_references.description: Ando's skills Charge him, granting him Elemental Essence and augmenting his skills for 1 turn. Using a skill while Charged will Supercharge him, granting him Elemental Essence and further augmenting his skills for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Electroblade
skill_references.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and marks them with Electroblade. While Charged, this skill also strikes any target affected by Electroblade. While Supercharged, this skill targets all enemies and deals 10 additional damage to targets marked by Electroblade.

skill_references.name: Flash Step
skill_references.description: Shatters target enemy until the end of Ando's next turn. While Charged, this skill lasts an additional turn. While Supercharged, this skill affects all targets marked by Electroblade.

skill_references.name: Expel Energy
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and removes Ando's charge state. If Ando was Charged, this skill deals 10 additional damage. If Ando was Supercharged, it deals 20 additional damage and becomes Piercing. This skill cannot be stunned and does not advance Ando's Charge state.

skill_references.name: Focus Power
skill_references.description: Ando advances to the next Charge state. Afterwards, if he is Charged, he strikes all enemies marked by Electroblade for 5 Piercing damage. If he is Supercharged, he marks a random enemy with Electroblade.

skill_references.name: Overclock
skill_references.description: For the next 3 turns, after using a Supercharged skill, Ando will become Charged and gain Elemental Essence. This skill can only be used while Supercharged, and extends the duration of his current Supercharge by 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Modular Core
skill_references.description: While Charged or Supercharged, Ando ignores non-damage effects.

skill_references.name: Slicing Spectrum
skill_references.description: Deals 15 Damage to the enemy team, along with an additional random effect from among: Deals 10 additional Affliction damage to all targets, Lowers all targets' damage by 5 for their next turn, Grants all allies 10 Shield, or Increases Ando's damage by 10 for his next turn.

skill_references.name: Capacitor Upgrade
skill_references.description: Expel Energy deals 5 more damage each time Ando gains Charged or Supercharged. This effect stacks and is removed when Expel Energy is used.

skill_references.name: Rev
skill_references.description: Deals 15 Damage to target enemy and generating another stack of Capacitor Upgrade. Every use of this skill wil generate an additional stack, up to 3.

skill_references.name: Conductive Combo
skill_references.description: Electroblade's Mark effect now lasts for Ando's next three turns.

skill_references.name: Rising Geyser
skill_references.description: Deals 20 Damage to target enemy and marks them with Rising Geyser for 3 turns. Targets marked by Rising Geyser replicate all new damage they receive to other marked targets.

skill_references.name: Ionic Cloaking
skill_references.description: Ando is Stealthed while Supercharged. (He will not trigger enemy effects.)

skill_references.name: Singularity

skill_references.name: Charge Absorption
skill_references.description: Whenever Ando's skills gain additional targets, he gains 10 Shield for each extra target affected.

skill_references.description: For 1 turn, any helpful skill used on target enemy will be reflected to Ando, and any damaging skills used on Ando will be reflected to target enemy. This skill is invisible.

skill_references.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. If used during Silent Avenger, this skill first removes all Shield from the target and its damage becomes Piercing.

skill_references.description: Aramao deals 5 more damage to the enemy Hero directly across from him, and he gains Elemental Essence whenever he damages them.

skill_references.name: Desert Knife
skill_references.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. If used on an enemy Hero that isn't directly across from Aramao, he will swap positions with the ally that is. Using this skill does not break Veiled.

skill_references.name: Sand Quake
skill_references.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to all enemies and extends the duration of all Veiled effects by 2 turns. Using this skill does not break Veiled.

skill_references.description: Aramao targets an enemy Hero for 1 turn. If they are directly across from Aramao, he will counter the first non-Strategic skill they use. If they are not, he will counter the first Strategic skill they use.

skill_references.name: Desert Veil
skill_references.description: Targets an allied Hero or Aramao. If targeting Aramao, applies Veiled to Aramao and a random allied Hero for 2 turns. If targeting an ally, applies Veiled to them and Aramao for 2 turns and swaps their positions.

skill_references.name: Heart of the Desert
skill_references.description: If there is only one Hero adjacent to Aramao, heal that Hero and Aramao for 15 HP. If there are two Heroes adjacent to Aramao, heal them both for 15 HP. This effect Bypasses.

skill_references.name: Trial of the Sands
skill_references.description: For 3 turns, all allied Heroes are Veiled at the end of each turn. During this time, Aramao will use Desert Knife on any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him. After being used, Aramao's team randomly swaps places once.

skill_references.name: Providence

skill_references.name: Devour Fear
skill_references.description: All stacks of Pure Horror are removed from all enemies. For each stack removed, Darkness-Outside-The-Door is healed for 10 HP.

skill_references.name: Final Night
skill_references.description: For the next 4 turns, all enemies receive 1 stack of Pure Horror each turn. During this time, enemies receive 5 Affliction damage for each stack of Pure Horror on them each turn.

skill_references.name: Pain Tolerance
skill_references.description: If Hector the Injector is on this Hero's team, Hector's passive won't create a minion at the start of the round, and all of Hector's skills that refer to Dennis will refer to this Hero instead. If Dennis is damaged, he will gain Elemental Essence and 5 Damage Reduction until the end of his next turn. This effect stacks, but does not refresh. Dennis can only gain Elemental Essence from this effect once per turn.

skill_references.name: Big Green Fist
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each stack of Pain Tolerance currently on Dennis.

skill_references.name: HS-112 Fury Serum
skill_references.description: For 4 turns any unit Dennis damages and any unit that damages him is Taunted for 1 turn. This effect can not stack on enemies or Dennis.

skill_references.name: HS-46 Ascendant Serum
skill_references.description: Dennis takes 5 Affliction damage, ignores non-damage effects for 1 turn, and Big Green Fist deals 10 more damage until the end of his next turn.

skill_references.name: Shared Agony
skill_references.description: Dennis deals 5 damage to all enemy units, and all enemy units deal 5 Piercing damage to him.

skill_references.name: HS-88 Reconstitution Serum
skill_references.description: Dennis heals 5 HP each turn (stacks).

skill_references.name: End of Shift
skill_references.description: Dennis takes 25 Affliction damage, then uses HS-112 Fury Serum, HS-46 Ascendant Serum, and HS-88 Reconstitution Serum on himself.

skill_references.name: Dwindling Flame
skill_references.description: Fate can only be healed by his own skills and effects. While his HP is at or above 50, allies affected by Fox Fire deal 5 more non-Affliction damage. While his HP is below 50, enemies affected by Fox Fire deal 5 less non-Affliction damage.

skill_references.name: Fox Fire
skill_references.description: Target enemy or ally is marked by Fox Fire for 4 turns. During this time, if they use or receive a new Harmful skill, they will take 5 Affliction damage if they are an enemy or heal 5 HP if they are an ally. When affected units use new skills on Fate, he gains Elemental Essence. Refreshes if applied on an already affected target.

skill_references.name: Will-o'-wisp
skill_references.description: Fate deals 5 Affliction damage to himself, then gives his team 10 Shield for 2 turns. During this time, any enemy that uses a new Harmful skill on Fate or his allies will receive 10 Affliction damage (this damage can only trigger once per skill).

skill_references.name: Vulpus Incendia
skill_references.description: Fate deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy each turn. As long as this skill remains active, Fox Fire deals double damage when triggered. Channeled.

skill_references.name: Vulpus Crystallia
skill_references.description: Fate heals an ally 10 HP each turn. As long as this skill remains active, Fox Fire gives double healing when triggered. Channeled.

skill_references.name: Fox's Cunning
skill_references.description: For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill will be affected by Fox Fire. This effect is invisible.

skill_references.name: This Is Not The End
skill_references.description: For the next 2 turns, the first time Fate or an ally would die, they are returned to 40 HP instead. Afterward, the revived Hero heals 5 HP for every active Fox Fire. This skill can only be triggered once per round.

skill_references.name: Yggdrasil's Bounty
skill_references.description: At the start of the game, Gaia creates two Seedling minions.

skill_references.name: Sprout Seedling
skill_references.description: Creates a Seedling minion. Maximum 3.

skill_references.name: Worldfist
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for each time Channel Earth has been used this battle.

skill_references.name: Channel Vitality
skill_references.description: Gaia heals target ally for 10 HP. For the rest of the turn, if any of Gaia's minions act, that ally will be healed for 10 HP.

skill_references.name: Rampart
skill_references.description: Gaia gains 20 permanent Shield, increased by 5 for each time Channel Earth has been used this battle.

skill_references.name: Worldmarch
skill_references.description: All active Seedling minions become Worldsprout minions permanently.

skill_references.name: Rotten Vitality
skill_references.description: Seedling Minions return to the battlefield 1 turn after they die.

skill_references.name: Decompose
skill_references.description: Target enemy loses 20 health. This health loss is not considered damage of any kind.

skill_references.name: Roiling Life
skill_references.description: Enemies damaged by Worldfist take 10 damage on the following turn. This effect lasts one additional turn with each time Channel Earth has been used.

skill_references.name: Overgrowth
skill_references.description: Deals 50 Piercing damage to target enemy. This effect Bypasses if the target is affected by Roiling Life

skill_references.name: Magnetic Shielding
skill_references.description: When Rampart's Shield takes damage, Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth.

skill_references.name: Ancient Railgun
skill_references.description: Removes all Shield from Gaia and then deals Piercing damage to target enemy equal to the Shield removed. This skill cannot be countered.

skill_references.name: Rising Indignation
skill_references.description: Whenever Gaia receives new damage, the cost of Gaia's Fury is reduced by [65], stacking. At 3 stacks, Gaia's Fury is automatically cast. During this time, Moonspike may not be used, and the Gaia's Fury minion deals and receives 10 additional damage.

skill_references.name: Gaia's Fury
skill_references.description: For 3 turns, Gaia is stunned and ignores damage. She creates a Gaia, Enraged minion with HP equal to her current HP.

skill_references.name: Branch of the World Tree
skill_references.description: Channel Vitality now costs [65] and affects all targets, but can only target minions.

skill_references.name: Yggdrasil
skill_references.description: Summons a World Tree minion. This skill costs [39] less for each Seedling minion Gaia controls.

skill_references.name: Oasis
skill_references.description: At the end of each turn, if Gaia or her allied Heroes did not have Elemental Essence, they gain Elemental Essence and heal 10 HP.

skill_references.name: Sandstorm
skill_references.description: Deals 5 damage to the enemy team for 4 turns. During this time, Rampart costs [65], and enemies damaged by Worldfist are Blinded for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Sacred Grove
skill_references.description: Until they use a Harmful skill, the allied Heroes heal for 5 health per turn. If an ally under this effect is damaged, the attacker is marked by Sacred Grove.

skill_references.name: Expel Intruders
skill_references.description: Target enemy marked by Sacred Grove takes 15 damage and is stunned for 1 turn. This consumes the mark and will not remove Sacred Grove from Gaia.

skill_references.name: Nutrient Sludge
skill_references.description: Whenever Gaia gains a stack of Channel Earth, she heals all allied minions 5 HP. If they are at max HP, they gain 5 max HP.

skill_references.name: Life From the Loam
skill_references.description: Heals all allied units for 25 HP. Whenever an allied unit dies, this skill costs 1 less [22] for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Shroomtender
skill_references.description: Instead of Seedling minions, Gaia now begins play with one Mushroom minion.

skill_references.name: Sow the Spores
skill_references.description: Deals 10 affliction damage to the enemy team, increased by 10 for each Mushroom Minion in the game.

skill_references.name: Nurturing Light
skill_references.description: At the end of her turn, all active Seedling minions gain 10 max HP.

skill_references.name: Sunbeam
skill_references.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each 20 HP among Seedling minions Gaia controls. After using this skill, all Seedling minions have their max HP returned to their default.

skill_references.name: Killing Frenzy
skill_references.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to all enemies.

skill_references.name: Moon Spike
skill_references.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 5 per 10 HP Gaia is missing.

skill_references.name: Poison Puff
skill_references.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to one enemy.

skill_references.name: Fruit of the World Tree
skill_references.description: Heals target ally for 20 health.

skill_references.name: Ancient Roots
skill_references.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy.

skill_references.name: Channel Earth
skill_references.description: Gaia gains Elemental Essence and 1 permanent stack of Channel Earth.

skill_references.name: Treant Smash
skill_references.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy.

skill_references.name: Vitality Transfer
skill_references.description: Heals target ally for the Worldsprout's current HP. After using this skill, the Worldsprout will die.

skill_references.name: The Storm Builds
skill_references.description: Galazax's damaging skills apply a stack of The Storm Builds. Galazax gains Elemental Essence if he uses a skill while Channeling.

skill_references.name: The Sky Darkens
skill_references.description: Galazax deals 5 Piercing damage to all enemies each turn. Cannot be used while active.

skill_references.name: Lightning Strikes
skill_references.description: Galazax deals 10 damage to target enemy and 5 damage to a random enemy.

skill_references.name: Pressure Rises
skill_references.description: Galazax moves all stacks of The Storm Builds from target enemy to himself. If 2 or more stacks are removed, this deals 5 Piercing damage to the target. If 4 or more stacks are removed, stun the target for 1 turn. Using this skill does not interrupt Channeling.

skill_references.name: The Heavens Speak
skill_references.description: Consumes all stacks of The Storm Builds on Galazax, dealing 10 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each stack and applying that many stacks of The Storm Builds to the target.

skill_references.name: Thunder Deafens
skill_references.description: Galazax becomes untargetable and ignores all damage for 1 turn. Using this skill does not interrupt Channeling.

skill_references.name: The Vortex Consumes
skill_references.description: Galazax deals 15 Piercing damage to all enemies each turn for 3 turns. This skill applies an extra stack of The Storm Builds to all targets. To use this skill, Galazax must consume 10 stacks of The Storm Builds from himself and must be Channeling The Sky Darkens.

skill_references.name: Frost-Covered
skill_references.description: At the start of each round, Gommar gains Frost-Covered, enhancing his skills. If Gommar damages an enemy with reduced damage, he gains Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Iceblood Hammer
skill_references.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy and lower their damage by 5 for 3 turns. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, he then deals 10 damage to the enemy team.

skill_references.name: Foot of the Mountain
skill_references.description: Deals 20 damage to the enemy team. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, enemies have their strategic skills stunned for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Breath of the North
skill_references.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy and lowers their damage by 5 until the end of Gommar's next turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, this skill cannot be countered and deals Piercing damage.

skill_references.name: Ice Body
skill_references.description: Makes Gommar invulnerable to non-strategic skills for 1 turn and regains Frost-Covered. If he was already Frost-Covered, he gains Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Absolute Zero
skill_references.description: All enemies and allies have their non-Strategic skills stunned for 1 turn. If Gommar is not Frost-Covered, he is also stunned.

skill_references.name: Forced Adaptation
skill_references.description: While Gommar is Frost-Covered, he ignores non-damage effects.

skill_references.name: Cold Snap
skill_references.description: Stuns target enemy's Strategic Skills for 1 turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, the target also receives 15 damage.

skill_references.name: Dazzling Lights
skill_references.description: The first enemy to use a skill on Gommar while he is Frost-Covered will have their skill costs increased by [65] for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Aurora Veil
skill_references.description: Gommar's team becomes invulnerable to Strategic skills for 1 turn. The following turn, they are invulnerable to non-Strategic skills.

skill_references.name: Frosted Facets
skill_references.description: Gommar takes half damage from new Harmful skills.

skill_references.name: Crystalline Smash
skill_references.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy and 10 damage to both the target's allies. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, all damaged enemies have their Strategic Skills stunned for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Glacial Advance
skill_references.description: At the start of each round, Gommar gains 5 Damage Reduction and is stunned for 2 turns. When this effect expires, he permanently ignores stun effects.

skill_references.name: Glacier Crash
skill_references.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies.

skill_references.name: Icy Blood
skill_references.description: Gommar ignores periodic Affliction damage.

skill_references.name: Frozen Heart
skill_references.description: For his next 2 turns, Gommar is permanently Frost-Covered and ignores harmful non-damage effects. When this skill ends, Gommar dies.

skill_references.name: Two Crowns
skill_references.description: At the start of each round, Gommar summons Bjorn, True King.

skill_references.name: King's Saddle
skill_references.description: For the next 3 turns, Bjorn, True King is stunned and redirects any damage Gommar would take to himself. If Gommar consumes Frost-Covered, Bjorn, True King will cast Sovereign's Howl on a random enemy. Cannot be used if Bjorn, True King has been killed.

skill_references.name: Black Ice
skill_references.description: While Gommar is Frost-Covered, he is Stealthed.

skill_references.name: Midnight Mountain
skill_references.description: Deals 45 damage to target enemy. If Gommar is Stealthed, this skill Bypasses. If used while Frost-Covered, lowers the target's damage by 10 for 3 turns.

skill_references.name: Snowy Glare
skill_references.description: Whenever Gommar gains Frost-Covered, enemies with lowered damage are Blinded for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Dancing Lights
skill_references.description: Gommar gives his team 10 Damage Reduction for 2 turns, healing them for 5 HP per turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, he deals 10 piercing damage to the enemy team for 2 turns.

skill_references.name: Natural Cryogenics
skill_references.description: While Frost-Covered, Gommar heals for 15 health per turn if he takes no action.

skill_references.name: Keeper of Beasts
skill_references.description: Creates a Frozen Beast minion. This minion is permanently stunned until Gommar loses Frost-Covered.

skill_references.name: Hypothermia
skill_references.description: When Gommar deals new damage to an enemy, he increases the damage they receive from all sources by 5 for 2 turns. This effect does not stack.

skill_references.name: Howling Gale
skill_references.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. If the target was already affected by Hypothermia, they are stunned for 1 turn. If Gommar is Frost-Covered, they are stunned for 2 turns instead.

skill_references.name: Sovereign's Howl
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy for 2 turns, and lowers the damage they deal by 5 permanently.

skill_references.name: Might of the Bjorn
skill_references.description: Target ally gains 5 increased damage and 10 Damage Reduction for 2 turns.

skill_references.name: Frozen Fangs
skill_references.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy

skill_references.name: Dennis the Apprentice
skill_references.description: At the start of each round, Hector summons Dennis the Apprentice. Whenever Hector uses a Serum skill on Dennis, he gains Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Burning Blood Serum
skill_references.description: Injects Dennis with Burning Blood Serum, increasing his damage dealt by 10 for 3 turns. This effect stacks, but Dennis takes 10 damage per turn per stack.

skill_references.name: Stoneseal Serum
skill_references.description: Injects Dennis with Stoneseal Serum, healing him for 10 health per turn for 3 turns, but increasing his skill costs by 1 Generic energy.

skill_references.name: Mindfog Serum
skill_references.description: Injects Dennis with Mindfog Serum, increasing his cooldowns by 1 and making him ignore stuns and counters for 3 turns. During this time, Lumbering Smash will stun its targets non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Protect Me!
skill_references.description: Reflects all harmful skills used on Hector to Dennis for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skill_references.name: Serum Overload
skill_references.description: Refreshes the duration of all Serums affecting Dennis to 3 turns, and removes their negative effects. If Dennis is dead and he was a minion when he died, he returns to life with 50HP.

skill_references.name: Cure-All
skill_references.description: Hector's Serums may now target any of his allies, and they remove one harmful effect on application and expiration.

skill_references.name: Inoculation
skill_references.description: Target ally is cleansed of all enemy effects, and cannot be affected by those effects for the rest of the game.

skill_references.name: Got a Job To Do
skill_references.description: Hector's Serums can now only be used on enemies. Being affected by a Serum also causes the target to receive 5 affliction damage for 3 turns.

skill_references.name: To Your Health!
skill_references.description: For 2 turns, if target enemy uses a skill they will receive 15 Affliction damage and be stunned for 1 turn. If this skill ends without being triggered, Hector and the enemy team heal 15 HP. The target of this skill is invisible.

skill_references.name: Borrowed Time
skill_references.description: Applies a random Serum to Dennis that he isn't already affected by whenever Hector gains energy from Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Serum Synthesizer
skill_references.description: Creates a Synthesizer minion.

skill_references.name: Apprenticeborn Pathogen
skill_references.description: Enemies damaged by Dennis receive Apprenticeborn Pathogen. This deals 5 damage the turn it is applied, lowers the target's damage by 10 for 1 turn the following turn, and then stuns the target on the final turn. Cannot be applied to enemies affected by Mutated Strain or Apprenticeborn Pathogen.

skill_references.name: Mutated Strain
skill_references.description: Places a mutated version of Apprenticeborn Pathogen onto target enemy whose effects work in reverse order. The damage reduction effect is twice as strong, and the damage effect is five times as strong. Cannot be applied to enemies affected by Mutated Strain or Apprenticeborn Pathogen.

skill_references.name: Dennisyphus
skill_references.description: All of Hector's [14] costs change to [65], but he no longer generates an Energy each turn. Dennis the Apprentice will use Lumbering Smash on a random enemy every turn.

skill_references.name: Pulverizing Smash
skill_references.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. At the beginning of Hector's next turn, he gains 1 Generic Energy.

skill_references.name: Perfect Form
skill_references.description: Hector consumes Dennis at the beginning of the round, gaining 50 Shield and 3 Elemental Essence. Hectors Serums now only target himself, and last 2 turns instead of 3.

skill_references.name: Morphic Strike
skill_references.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If Hector is affected by Burning Blood Serum, this skill deals 5 additional damage and becomes Piercing. If he is affected by Stoneseal Serum, he heals for 10 health. If he is affected by Mindfog Serum, he becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: A Dash of Whimsy
skill_references.description: Hector will use a random serum on the first character to use a skill on him each turn

skill_references.name: A Sprinkle of Recklessness
skill_references.description: If used on an ally, lowers the cost of their helpful skills by [65] for 1 turn and if they use a new skill, they will gain Elemental Essence. If used on an enemy, increases the cost of their Harmful skills by [65] for 1 turn and if they do not use a new skill during this time they will be stunned for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Try the Supply
skill_references.description: Applies any Serums Hector uses to himself as well.

skill_references.name: Avatar Serum
skill_references.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies for each serum on Hector each turn for 3 turns. During this time he ignores non-damage effects.

skill_references.name: Lingering Spores
skill_references.description: Whenever a Serum effect ends, a stack of Lingering Spores is placed on Dennis and a random enemy, dealing 5 affliction damage per turn if they are an enemy, and 5 healing per turn if they are an ally. This effect stacks.

skill_references.name: Acceleration Serum
skill_references.description: After 3 turns, the target receives 40 affliction damage. On application, this effect lowers its duration by 1 turn for each stack of Lingering Spores on the target.

skill_references.name: Rejuvenation Serum
skill_references.description: Any time an allied Hero becomes invulnerable, they heal 5 health for 3 turns.

skill_references.name: Rejuvenation Pod
skill_references.description: Gives an ally under the effect of Rejuvenation Serum 30 Shield, and the duration of Rejuvenation Serum is refreshed to maximum.

skill_references.name: Synthesize Serum
skill_references.description: The Synthesizer stores a permanent copy of all Serums on the target that it does not currently hold.

skill_references.name: Catalyze Serum
skill_references.description: The Synthesizer applies all of its stored serums to target unit.

skill_references.name: Lumbering Smash
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy.

skill_references.name: Cinders
skill_references.description: When Jarrik damages an enemy marked by this skill, he deals 10 additional Affliction damage and gains Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Blade of Ashes
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and permanently marks them with Cinders.

skill_references.name: Cinderswell
skill_references.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies. If any target is marked by Cinders, all enemies are Shattered for 2 turns.

skill_references.name: Call Cinders
skill_references.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies marked by Cinders. Those marks are then removed, creating a Cinderling minion for each mark removed.

skill_references.name: Wall of Sparks
skill_references.description: Grants Jarrik 15 Shield for 1 turn for each active Cinders mark or Cinderling minion.

skill_references.name: Blade of Dancing Lights
skill_references.description: Withdraws all active Cinders marks and consumes any active Cinderling minions. For a number of turns equal to the total consumed, Blade of Ashes targets all enemies and Jarrik will automatically create a Cinderling minion whenever he triggers his Cinders.

skill_references.name: Drunken Swordsman
skill_references.description: Jarrik will deal 10 piercing damage to any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on him. At the end of each turn, Jarrik will deal 10 piercing damage to a random enemy.

skill_references.name: Cindersprig Brew
skill_references.description: Jarrik or target ally deal 5 more non-Affliction damage for the next 4 turns. This effect will end if they use a new skill.

skill_references.name: Final Breath
skill_references.description: The first time Jarrik dies, he instead becomes Immortal for one turn.

skill_references.name: Last Light
skill_references.description: Jarrik deals damage equal to his missing HP to target enemy.

skill_references.name: Scorched Flesh
skill_references.description: Enemies affected by Cinders have the cost of their Strategic skills increased by [65].

skill_references.name: Brimsteel Scabbard
skill_references.description: Jarrik's next Blade of Ashes deals triple damage, cannot be countered, and if it strikes an enemy affected by Cinders, it automatically creates a Cinderling minion

skill_references.name: Belphegor's Blade
skill_references.description: Each turn that Jarrik or an enemy affected by Cinders doesn't use a new skill, they receive 15 Affliction damage.

skill_references.name: Chains of Sloth
skill_references.description: For the next 3 turns, target enemy's skills cost 1 more [65], increasing by 1 each turn. Each time they use a new skill, this effect's current magnitude decreases by 1.

skill_references.name: Drake Transformation
skill_references.description: At the end of each turn and whenever he consumes a mark from Cinders, Jarrik heals 5 HP and permanently deals 5 more Affliction damage.

skill_references.name: Drakken
skill_references.description: Deals 40 Affliction damage to target enemy. After using this skill, Jarrik can no longer apply, trigger, or consume Cinders.

skill_references.name: Pursuit of Justice
skill_references.description: Jarrik can no longer be stunned or countered.

skill_references.name: Execution Sentence
skill_references.description: Target enemy gains 5 stacks of Execution Sentence. Each time they use a skill, one stack will be removed. When they have no more stacks, they are instantly killed.

skill_references.name: Blazer Board
skill_references.description: Whenever Jarrik consumes a mark from Cinders, he becomes Invulnerable until the end of his next turn. This effect is automatically activated at the start of each round.

skill_references.name: Pop Off
skill_references.description: Jarrik deals 10 Affliction damage to target enemy. If they were marked by Cinders, he consumes the mark. If they weren't, he applies Cinders to them. This skill is only usable the turn after activating Blazer Board.

skill_references.name: Blue Flame Spirits
skill_references.description: Cinderling minions are replaced by Azure Sparkling minions.

skill_references.name: Awakener's Spark
skill_references.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage and applies Cinders to up to 3 different, random enemies.

skill_references.name: Ritual of the Reaper
skill_references.description: When Jarrik takes or deals damage, he gains that much Ritual Power, up to a maximum of 120.

skill_references.name: Scythe of Cinders
skill_references.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy and marks them with Cinders. Can only be used if Ritual of the Reaper has at least 60 Ritual Power. If Ritual of the Reaper has 120 Ritual Power, this skill will strike its target twice.

skill_references.name: Dusken Ascendant
skill_references.description: Jarrik is permanently Blinded and creates one Cinder minion at the end of each turn.

skill_references.name: Dawnbreak
skill_references.description: For the next 3 turns, all enemies are treated as though they are affected by Cinders. This effect cannot be consumed to create Cinderling minions.

skill_references.name: Cinder Splash
skill_references.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to the enemy team, killing the Cinder minion.

skill_references.name: Cinder Splash
skill_references.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to the enemy team.

skill_references.name: Awakened Spark
skill_references.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to all enemies, Bypassing.

skill_references.name: Tales to Tell
skill_references.description: Keeper of Fables gains Elemental Essence whenever one of his allies does. Whenever this occurs, he gains 10 Shield.

skill_references.name: Page-turner
skill_references.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 25 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, he deals 25 damage to target enemy.

skill_references.name: Character Development
skill_references.description: Keeper of Fables attempts to consume 25 Shield from Tales to Tell. If he does, he heals target ally for 30 HP.

skill_references.name: Chronicle Deeds

skill_references.name: Saya Cell

skill_references.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to the enemy team. If any enemies are marked by Eyes of Vengeance, this skill will consume 1 stack from each to reduce this skill's cooldown by 1 turn for each marked consumed.

skill_references.name: Heavenly Parry

skill_references.name: Proactivity Protocol

skill_references.name: Skylance
skill_references.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to one enemy.

skill_references.description: Prisma Citrine prepares to redirect a teammate towards a targeted enemy. If a skill is redirected this way, the targeted enemy deals 5 less damage for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Prisma Launch
skill_references.description: Until the end of the next turn, Prisma Saffron's skills will Bypass against target enemy. If used on another Prisma Ranger that is using their Lens, their skills will also Bypass during this time and they become invulnerable for one turn.

skill_references.name: Saffron Beam
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Dream Body
skill_references.description: Whenever this Hero is the sole target of a skill, he gains Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Reveal Hidden Truth
skill_references.description: Xyris deals 15 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Enter the Dreamscape
skill_references.description: Xyris deals 20 damage to target enemy and stuns their helpful skills for 2 turns. While active, Xyris gains Elemental Essence each turn.

skill_references.name: Twisted Nightmares
skill_references.description: Xyris deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, their AOE skills become single-target.

skill_references.name: Somnic Apparition
skill_references.description: Xyris counters the next Harmful skill used by target enemy for 1 turn. If countered this way, Xyris creates a Dream Reflection minion (HP:35) with a copy of the countered skill (its Specific costs change to Xyris' current Element.) This effect is invisible.

skill_references.name: Echoes of Desire
skill_references.description: The next skill used by target ally will occur twice. Cannot target Xyris.

skill_references.name: Before I Wake
skill_references.description: When Enter the Dreamscape ends, affected enemies receive damage equal to the damage they received while it was active.

skill_references.name: Dream Knife
skill_references.description: Deals 15 damage to an enemy affected by Enter the Dreamscape.

skill_references.name: Hypnagogic Curse
skill_references.description: Xyris now starts the game at 1HP. Damage now heals him, and healing damages him. Xyris will now die when he reaches 100 HP.

skill_references.name: Dream Weaving
skill_references.description: Xyris and a targeted Hero swap their current HP.

skill_references.name: Dreamform Paradox
skill_references.description: Whenever Dream Body triggers, the cooldown on Astral Rejection and Somnic Apparition are reduced by 1.

skill_references.name: Astral Rejection
skill_references.description: Target Hero is Banished (Stunned, Untargetable, Invulnerable) for 1 turn. This effect cancels any skills that they had delayed.

skill_references.name: Dark Arcadia
skill_references.description: Enter the Dreamscape now affects all living units.

skill_references.name: Phantasia Pulse
skill_references.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each hero with Elemental Essence on the enemy team. Xyris is healed for 10 HP for each hero with Elemental Essence on his team.

skill_references.name: Darkness and Truth
skill_references.description: Simulacrums and Dream Reflections ignore counters and stuns.

skill_references.name: Simulacrum
skill_references.description: Xyris targets one ally or enemy and creates a Simulacrum minion that possesses their Basic skills. Simulacrums are created with 30 HP and their specific costs are the same as Xyris's.

skill_references.name: Captured Humanity
skill_references.description: Enemies countered by Dream Reflection are permanently Mooncursed. (Mooncursed characters have their Strategic skills stunned, deal 5 more non-affliction damage, and suffer 10 Affliction damage each turn.)

skill_references.name: Wild Hunt
skill_references.description: Xyris targets all Mooncursed units. For 3 turns, they are Shattered and Isolated. Allied targets deal 5 more non-Affliction damage with new skills.

skill_references.name: Quiet Nightmare
skill_references.description: Xyris will Silence enemies that he damages for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Spine Chill
skill_references.description: Xyris deals 20 damage to all enemies and Paralyzes their cooldowns for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Dream Infiltration
skill_references.description: Enter the Dreamscape no longer deals damage, but targets all enemies. Xyris's skills Bypass against targets affected by Enter the Dreamscape.

skill_references.name: Steal Secrets
skill_references.description: Xyris targets one enemy and creates a Dream Reflection minion with a copy of the skill that the targeted enemy used last. Can only be used on a target affected by Enter the Dreamscape, and will fail if the target has not yet used a skill.

skill_references.name: Shadow Court Ritual
skill_references.description: Any time Elemental Essence is gained, Xyris gains 5 Ritual Power. After reaching 75 Ritual Power, all units have their skill cooldowns reduced by 1.

skill_references.name: Heartfire
skill_references.description: Target unit receives 20 Affliction damage. Xyris and the target both gain Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Dreams of Power
skill_references.description: Xyris deals 5 more damage to enemies with Elemental Essence, and gains Elemental Essence when using Harmful skills on them.

skill_references.name: Sacred Severing
skill_references.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy, cancels any cancellable skill they are using, and Silences them for 2 turns.

skill_references.name: Dream Reflection
skill_references.description: A Skill to be replaced with the countered skill.

skill_references.name: Biting Wind
skill_references.description: Any time an enemy unit becomes invulnerable, Zephyrex deals 15 piercing damage to them first.

skill_references.name: Arcadian Duet
skill_references.description: Target enemy becomes Invulnerable and Isolated until the end of their next turn.

skill_references.name: Elegant Sweep
skill_references.description: On the following turn, Zephyrex deals 25 piercing damage to all enemy Heroes. This skill is Channeled (Being stunned or using a new skill will cancel it).

skill_references.name: Sonic Thrust
skill_references.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn. This skill Bypasses Invulnerability and can only be used if Wind Step is on cooldown.

skill_references.name: Wind Step
skill_references.description: Zephyrex gains 15 damage reduction for 1 turn. This effect is Invisible. If Zephyrex receives a new skill during this time, he gains Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Perfect Execution
skill_references.description: Zephyrex deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and gives himself Perfection until the end of his next turn. If Perfection expires, this skill will be disabled for the remainder of the round. Each time this skill is used, it permanently deals 15 more damage.

skill_references.name: Brush of Wings
skill_references.description: Elegant Sweep deals 10 less damage, but also heals Zephyrex's team for 10 health.

skill_references.name: Light of Raphael
skill_references.description: For 3 turns, Zephyrex gains 20 Shield. During this time, Elegant Sweep hits instantly.

skill_references.name: Cloud Step
skill_references.description: Wind Step now lasts an additional turn.

skill_references.name: Waft
skill_references.description: Zephyrex becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill can only be used during Wind Step. If Wind Step triggered last turn, deal 10 Piercing damage to all enemies, Bypassing.

skill_references.name: Fae Prince
skill_references.description: Every turn that an enemy Hero doesn't deal damage to Zephyrex, that enemy receives 10 additional damage from Zephyrex's next damaging ability.

skill_references.name: Prod
skill_references.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, and increases the damage of the next skill they use on Zephyrex by 10 (this effect does not stack).

skill_references.name: Fell Wind
skill_references.description: Biting Wind now causes health loss, which does not count as any form of damage.

skill_references.name: Soulsteal
skill_references.description: For the next 3 turns, target enemy becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn at the end of each of their turns

skill_references.name: Winds of Summer
skill_references.description: Biting Wind and Elegant Sweep now deal Affliction damage.

skill_references.name: Blazing Flourish
skill_references.description: Deals 30 Affliction Damage to 1 enemy. The following turn, Elegant Sweep costs 1 less [65].

skill_references.name: Wingless Wanderer
skill_references.description: Zephyrex can no longer be stunned during Elegant Sweep. If he receives a new harmful skill while preparing, he will gain Elemental Essence and reset his use of Perfect Execution.

skill_references.name: Cleave the Veil
skill_references.description: Zephyrex targets one enemy. At the end of his next turn, if he has not received a new harmful skill, he deals 45 piercing damage to the targeted enemy. Enemy players see this effect as Elegant Sweep. Channeled.

skill_references.name: Vacuum Blade
skill_references.description: Any time Biting Wind or Wind Step triggers, Elegant Sweep permanently deals 5 more damage.

skill_references.name: Vacuum Style: Blade Prison
skill_references.description: Zephyrex makes target enemy Invulnerable and Isolated for 1 turn. This effect will be reapplied as long as Zephyrex channels it.

skill_references.name: Sand Spectre
skill_references.description: Zephyrex cannot be chosen as a target by Blinded skills.

skill_references.name: Sand in the Eyes
skill_references.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and blinds them for 3 turns. If the target becomes Invulnerable, this effect is removed.

skill_references.name: Ominous Rumble
skill_references.description: Triggering Wind Step marks enemies with Ominous Rumble. Marked enemies are automatically targeted by Arcadian Duet and Jolt, consuming the mark in the process.

skill_references.name: Jolt
skill_references.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, Bypassing. If the enemy is affected by Ominous Rumble, Zephyrex gains Elemental Essence.

skill_references.name: Cold and Alone
skill_references.description: Enemies gain 1 stack of Cold and Alone every turn they are Invulnerable or Isolated. Upon reaching 3 stacks, the target is stunned for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Winter's Bite
skill_references.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy, and any enemy marked by Cold and Alone.

skill_references.name: Oceans Gather
skill_references.description: When Zev'kir reaches 1 stack of Call Tides, he gains Elemental Essence. When he reaches 2 stacks, his harmful skills will stun their primary target for 1 turn. When he reaches 3 stacks, his skills affect all valid targets.

skill_references.name: Call Tides
skill_references.description: Zev'kir begins Channelling, gaining a stack of Call Tides each turn. These stacks are consumed on him using a new non-Strategic skill.

skill_references.name: Riptide
skill_references.description: Zev'kir deals 5 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 damage per stack of Call Tides Zev'kir has.

skill_references.name: Bubble Prison
skill_references.description: Zev'kir deals 15 damage to target enemy for 1 turn, increased by 1 turn per stack of Call Tides Zev'kir has. This skill will end if Zev'kir is stunned.

skill_references.name: Repulse
skill_references.description: Zev'kir counters the first harmful skill received by target ally. If a skill is countered, Zek'vir will automatically begin channeling Call Tides. This effect is invisible.

skill_references.name: Tidal Wave
skill_references.description: Zev'kir deals 45 piercing damage to target enemy. This skill costs 1 less [2] per stack of Call Tides Zev'kir has.

skill_references.name: Submerged Leyline
skill_references.description: Zevkir's allies deal 5 additional damage while he Channels Call Tides.

skill_references.name: Leyline Bolt
skill_references.description: Deals 25 Damage to a random enemy. If used during Call Tides, it affects target enemy instead, and deals Piercing damage.

skill_references.name: Atlantean Hymn
skill_references.description: Allies heal for 5 health per turn during Call Tides.

skill_references.name: Purelight Pool
skill_references.description: Heals target ally for 20 health. This causes 5 additional healing for every stack of Call Tides on Zev'Kir

skill_references.name: Sanguine Spectre
skill_references.description: Zev'kir heals for 10 health whenever he deals damage. If he is at full health, he instead gains a stack of Call Tides.

skill_references.name: Crimson Tide
skill_references.description: Zev'kir targets all enemies, losing 5 health for each enemy targeted. The following turn, each targeted enemy takes 15 Affliction Damage, plus 5 for each stack of Call Tides on Zev'kir.

skill_references.name: Static Maelstrom
skill_references.description: Channeling Call Tides now changes Zev'kir's costs to Generic, and causes him to deal 10 additional damage with his next ability.

skill_references.name: Crackling Slipstream
skill_references.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy. If Zev'kir has at least 3 stacks of Call Tides, he applies Static Maelstrom to his team for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Freezing Brine
skill_references.description: Damaging enemies with Riptide adds a stack of Freezing Brine for each stack of Call Tides on Zev'kir. Upon reaching 5 stacks, the enemy is stunned for 1 turn and the stacks are consumed.

skill_references.name: Cold Snap
skill_references.description: Targets all stunned allies and invulnerable enemies. Allies become invulnerable until their next turn, and enemies are stunned for their next turn.

skill_references.name: Patient Predation
skill_references.description: Call Tides will now continue until a new harmful skill is used on Zev'kir. The harmful skill is reflected to its user and Call Tides ends.

skill_references.name: Lens of the Deep
skill_references.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy, and for their next two turns that enemy will receive double damage from reflected skills.

skill_references.name: Misty Mire
skill_references.description: Bubble Prison will now target all enemies, dealing 15 Piercing damage to a random target per turn. This damage Bypasses

skill_references.name: Spear of Fog
skill_references.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If used on an enemy affected by Bubble Prison, deals double damage and Bypasses.

skill_references.name: Chains of Atlantis
skill_references.description: Whenever Zev'kir or his allies end their turn Channeling an ability, a random enemy gains a stack of Chains of Atlantis. Enemies marked by Chains of Atlantis receive 5 Affliction damage per stack during each turn of Call Tides.

skill_references.name: Abyssal Grasp
skill_references.description: Deals 30 damage to target enemy. If Zev'kir is Channeling Call Tides, this damage becomes Piercing. If the damaged enemy is marked by Chains of Atlantis, they are stunned for 1 turn.

skill_references.name: Rapid Mutation
skill_references.description: Zev'kir takes 5 Affliction Damage at the end of each of his turns. For every 15 Health he is missing, Zev'kir has one additional stack of Call Tides

skill_references.name: Mutable Form
skill_references.description: Zev'kir gains 10 Shield for 2 turns for each stack of Call Tides he has.

skill_references.name: Stinking Marsh
skill_references.description: When Zev'kir has no stacks of Call Tides, his skills are treated as though he had two, and deal Affliction damage instead. Whenever Zev'kir uses a skill with 0 stacks of Call Tides, he takes 10 Affliction damage.

skill_references.name: Rising Bog
skill_references.description: Zev'kir consumes his stacks of Call Tides, changing his costs to Generic costs and granting his team 10 Shield per turn. The duration is equal to the number of Call Tides stacks consumed.
